title: AMPK-mediated autophagy induction by bisdemethoxycurcumin attenuates senescence and amyloid pathology in 3xTg-AD mice.
abstract: Alzheimer disease (AD) pathology is accompanied by increased senescence and reduced levels of autophagy in the brain. We investigated whether pharmacologically inducing autophagy could alter the senescent phenotype and ameliorate AD pathology.
